verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage is an AML/KYC compliance vendor. A buyer comparing compliance and identity-adjacent vendors could reasonably ask about lawful biometric handling, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack covers only sanctions, PEP and adverse-media screening, risk scoring, webhooks, auth and case management. Nothing documents biometric processing, GDPR lawful bases, BIPA or other US biometric statutes, or consent language for an onboarding flow.
